brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories on rear faces: accessory:0#0,2#0 and accessory:0#-1,2#2 on wall-side cells, mounting by lifting onto wall screws.
Four hex-acc-hook plates (accessory:0#0,2#1, accessory:0#0,1#0, accessory:0#-1,2#3, accessory:0#0,1#1) each with two hooks = 8 hook positions across three connected cells.

finish.summary: Three-cell horizontal rack (0,1,0 + 0,2,0 + -1,2,0) locked with joint bolts, two keyhole hangers on the wall side for lifting onto screws, and four hook plates providing eight hooks for hand tools. Props limited by configurator to cable coils/gaffer tape on hook plates, but physical hooks will hold pliers, screwdrivers, etc.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
